question: Can malformed native middle-call completion cause extraction to bridge nonadjacent same-session calls?
expected_effect_vs_sample_error: Deterministic synthetic integrity qualification, no sample-size claim.
decision_rule: PASS iff ordered/shuffled controls yield two adjacent pairs and missing/invalid middle completion never yields pair 0→2; controlled source refusal is acceptable for malformed cases. UNSAFE identifies a parser prerequisite and establishes no live data outcome.
stop_rule: One bounded synthetic qualification; own SIGALRM at 120 seconds or earlier FILLER_DEADLINE/FILLER_END, with STOP and deadline checks per case. No process-group signals.
